entities.summary: Jacobus Sinapius or Jacobus Horcicky, later granted the title "de Tepenec", was a Czech pharmacist and personal doctor of Holy Roman Emperor Rudolf II. His latinized name Sinapius is a translation of his family name Hořčický, which means 'mustard' in Czech.
